## Updraft 0.7.2

- **Ask Claude about your meetings from the web and your phone.** claude.ai and the Claude phone app can now search your meeting transcripts and AI notes, read-only. Updraft goes online through Tailscale (free) only while you have it switched on, and nothing gets in without your pairing word and a code you type on your PC. Go to Settings > Connectors, turn on "Let web apps connect" and follow the checklist. Your dictation history is never offered to web or phone apps.
- **Screen recording** (off until you turn it on in Settings > General). Record your screen, mic and PC sound with a webcam bubble you can drag anywhere; Ctrl+Alt+R starts and stops it. Videos stay on this computer. Checked on Windows; the Mac version hasn't been tried on a Mac yet.
- **Faster meeting list.** Changes to your meetings folder no longer make Updraft freeze for a moment while it re-reads the list.

**To update:** Settings > About > Check for updates.
